Public specification:
You are to design a one-input one-output serial 2's complementer Moore state machine. The input (x) is a series of bits (one per clock cycle) beginning with the least-significant bit of the number, and the output (Z) is the 2's complement of the input. The machine will accept input numbers of arbitrary length. The circuit requires a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset. The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.

Input widths {'areset': 1, 'x': 1}; output widths {'z': 1}. Clock clk; sample after the posedge edge has settled. Each row's values are driven before the sampled edge. Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row. Protocol seed 20261123.
Return only executable Python with function reference(vectors). For each row return a dictionary with every output and a concrete unsigned integer within that output's bit width, even when power-up is unspecified. Preserve timing and process mid changes at the correct point. No imports, classes, prints, external files or executable code outside functions. Comments may label the contract rules.
Follow the supplied contract. Mark every rule ID in a Python comment where it is implemented. Use named state and explicit transitions where useful. Do not hardcode complete stimulus sequences.
